question.text: One mole of an ideal monoatomic gas is compressed isothermally in a rigid vessel to double its pressure at room temperature, $27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. The work done on the gas will be:

solution.text:
Work done on gas $=\mathrm{nRT} \ell n\left(\frac{p_f}{p_1}\right)$
$$
=\mathrm{R}(300) \ell \mathrm{n}(2)\left(\because \frac{P_f}{p_i}=2 \text { given }\right)
$$
